INSERT INTO explore_items (item_id, item_type, approval_status, visibility_status, reviewed_by, reviewed_at) VALUES
(#{itemId}, #{itemType}, 'APPROVED', 'VISIBLE', #{reviewedBy}, NOW())

INSERT INTO event (event_id, pipeline_id, event_kind, title, description, venue_name, thumbnail_url, image_urls, links, reservation_url, pre_reservation, start_date, end_date, status, is_permanent, operating_hours, open_days, open_weekend, opens_late, region1, region2, address_road, latitude, longitude, has_photo_zone, is_experience, age_limit, contact, organizer, is_free, price_text) VALUES
(#{itemIds[${i}]}, #{it.pipelineId}, COALESCE(#{it.eventKind}, 'ETC'), #{it.title}, #{it.description}, #{it.venueName}, #{it.thumbnailUrl}, #{it.imageUrls}, #{it.links}, #{it.reservationUrl}, #{it.preReservation}, #{it.startDate}, #{it.endDate}, COALESCE(UPPER(#{it.status}), 'SCHEDULED'), COALESCE(#{it.isPermanent}, FALSE), #{it.operatingHours}, #{it.openDays}, #{it.openWeekend}, #{it.opensLate}, #{it.region1}, #{it.region2}, #{it.addressRoad}, #{it.latitude}, #{it.longitude}, COALESCE(#{it.hasPhotoZone}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{it.isExperience}, FALSE), #{it.ageLimit}, #{it.contact}, #{it.organizer}, #{it.isFree}, #{it.priceText})

INSERT INTO place (place_id, pipeline_id, name, brand, branch, place_kind, thumbnail_url, image_urls, region1, region2, address_road, address_detail, postal_code, latitude, longitude, opening_hours, closed_days, tel, has_parking, reservable, takeout_available, has_restroom, menu_summary, is_active) VALUES
(#{itemIds[${i}]}, #{it.pipelineId}, #{it.name}, #{it.brand}, #{it.branch}, #{it.placeKind}, #{it.thumbnailUrl}, #{it.imageUrls}, #{it.region1}, #{it.region2}, #{it.addressRoad}, #{it.addressDetail}, #{it.postalCode}, #{it.latitude}, #{it.longitude}, #{it.openingHours}, #{it.closedDays}, #{it.tel}, #{it.hasParking}, #{it.reservable}, #{it.takeoutAvailable}, #{it.hasRestroom}, #{it.menuSummary}, COALESCE(#{it.isActive}, TRUE))
